content.text:
## Verdict

There is **no** `root-skills` (or any custom skills) plugin under Plugin Building. Skills are stock **mcMMO**, with RootMC reading MySQL and pushing to the cloud; Official’s cross-host mcMMO mirror is **off** because Claims and Towny already share one MySQL. No mentions of AdvancedSkills, Skills Odyssey, or skill trees anywhere in the workspace.

---

### 1. Root-skills / skills plugin projects under Plugin Building

**None found.**

- Active plugins live under `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Plugin Building\Minecraft\plugins\` — no folder named `root-skills`, `skills`, etc.
- Halted plugins under `...\halted-development\` also have no skills module (only incidental “mcmmo” topic strings in halted `root-ask`).
- Directory scan of the whole RootMC tree only finds live `plugins\mcMMO\` handoff/backup folders and world `mcmmo_regions` data.

mcMMO itself is a **third-party jar** (`mcMMO.jar`) in handoffs, not a Gradle module in this repo.

---

### 2. How RootMC / Official / PAPI hook into mcMMO

#### RootMC (`plugins/rootmc`)

| Piece | Path / name |
|---|---|
| Plugin entry | `...\plugins\rootmc\src\main\java\com\rootrecord\minecraft\rootmc\RootMcPlugin.java` — creates `McMMOStatsReader` when MySQL is up |
| Config | `...\plugins\rootmc\src\main\resources\rootmc.yml` → `mcmmo.enabled`, `mcmmo.table-prefix: "mcmmo_"` |
| Reader | `...\rootstat\mysql\McMMOStatsReader.java` |
| Model | `...\rootstat\model\McMMOPlayerSnapshot.java` (`uuid`, `username`, `powerLevel`, `skills`) |
| Config loader | `...\rootstat\config\RootStatConfig.java` |
| Sync loop | `...\rootstat\sync\SyncTask.java` → `buildServerSnapshots()` merges mcMMO + playtime |
| Cloud push | `...\rootstat\cloud\CloudApiClient.java` → `POST /api/realm/minecraft/mcmmo/sync` (`syncServerStats` / deprecated `syncMcmmo`) |
| Bridge | `...\rootstat\RootStatBridge.java` → `mcmmo()` |

**Tables read:** `{prefix}users` + `{prefix}skills` (default `mcmmo_users`, `mcmmo_skills`), join on `u.id = s.user_id`.

**Skill columns (modern):** mining, woodcutting, repair, unarmed, herbalism, excavation, archery, swords, axes, acrobatics, taming, fishing, alchemy, crossbows, tridents, maces, spears. Falls back to a legacy set without the last four if the modern query fails.

**Power level:** sum of those skill columns.

#### PlaceholderAPI

| Piece | Detail |
|---|---|
| Class | `RootStatExpansion.java` |
| Identifiers | Registers both `rootmc` and `rootstat` (legacy) from `RootMcPlugin` |
| Placeholders | `%rootmc_mcmmo_power%`, `%rootmc_mcmmo_power_level%`, and named `%rootmc_mcmmo_power_<username>%` (same for `rootstat_…`) |
| Behavior | Calls `McMMOStatsReader.powerByUsername()` — **power only**, not per-skill |

Changelog note: `Change Logs\plugins\rootmc.md` documents these as hologram-friendly alternatives to eCloud mcMMO expansions. Live tip in `Change Logs\SERVER-CHANGELOG.md`: `/papi ecloud download mcmmo` for native mcMMO PAPI.

RootMC `plugin.yml` softdepends on `PlaceholderAPI` (not on mcMMO — it reads MySQL directly).

#### RootMC-Official (`plugins/rootmc-official`)

| Piece | Path / name |
|---|---|
| Config | `rootmc-official.yml` → `peer.mcmmo-table-prefix`, `sync.datasets.mcmmo` |
| Sync | `ProgressionSyncService.java` → `syncMcMmo()`, `mergeMcMmoSkills()`, `MCMMO_SKILLS[]` |
| Config types | `OfficialConfig.java` |

**Behavior when enabled:** peer MySQL → local `mcmmo_users` / `mcmmo_skills`, merge skills with `GREATEST(...)`.

**Live setting (both hosts):** `sync.datasets.mcmmo: false` — comments say both hosts already share Towny MySQL for mcMMO.

- Claims: `...\Server Handoffs\1. RootMC - Claims\plugins\RootMC\rootmc-official.yml`
- Towny: `...\Server Handoffs\2. RootMC - Towny\plugins\RootMC\rootmc-official.yml`

#### Cloud / app surfaces (downstream of plugin sync)

- API: `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-realm-api\src\rootstat-minecraft.ts` — `MCMMO_SKILL_KEYS`, D1 table `rootstat_mcmmo_stats`, `POST …/mcmmo/sync`
- Public routes: `rootmc-server.ts` — `/{sid}/mcmmo/me`, `/{sid}/mcmmo/leaderboard`
- Android: `ServerRepository.kt` (`McMMOStats`, `fetchMyMcmmoOnServer`, leaderboard); UI in `RootMcServerScreen` / `LeaderboardsScreen`
- MySQL mirror helper: `rootmc-mysql-full-sync.ts` includes `mcmmo_` prefix discovery

---

### 3. Live mcMMO config highlights (Handoffs / Live Backups)

**Present on Claims, Towny, Test** under:

- `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Server Handoffs\{1,2,3}. RootMC - *\plugins\mcMMO\`
- Matching Live Backups trees

**Jar:** `mcMMO.jar` (+ `mcMMO\` config dir) on all three handoffs.

#### Claims & Towny (production-style)

`config.yml` (version banner ~2.2.053):

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| RetroMode | **Enabled** |
| Scoreboards | `UseScoreboards: false` |
| MySQL | **Enabled: true**, `TablePrefix: mcmmo_`, Shockbyte MySQL host, shared DB name pattern with RootMC |
| Party (config.yml) | FriendlyFire false, MaxSize -1, ExpShare bonuses, party Level_Cap 10, unlocks for chat/tp/alliance/item/xp share |
| Party system file | `party.yml` → `Party.Enabled: true` |
| Hardcore death/vampirism | All skills **false** |
| Abilities | Enabled |
| Skills list (all Level_Cap 0) | Acrobatics, Alchemy, Archery, Axes, Excavation, Fishing, Herbalism, Mining, Repair, Salvage, Smelting, Swords, Tridents, Crossbows, Maces, Spears, Taming, Unarmed, Woodcutting |

Note: Salvage/Smelting exist in mcMMO config but are **not** in RootMC’s MySQL skill-column sync list.

Other notable files in the live folder: `coreskills.yml`, `experience.yml`, `skillranks.yml`, `advanced.yml`, `chat.yml`, `treasures.yml`, `fishing_treasures.yml`, `repair.vanilla.yml`, `salvage.vanilla.yml`, `upgrades_overhaul.yml`, `persistent_data.yml`, `potions.yml`, `sounds.yml`, `custom_item_support.yml`.

#### Test Server

- MySQL **Enabled: false** (flatfile: `flatfile\mcmmo.users`)
- Same skill set / RetroMode pattern in config

Official live comments confirm Claims + Towny mcMMO both point at the **same Towny MySQL**, so Official does not double-sync.

---

### 4. Plugin build structure (Gradle / Paper)

Root: `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Plugin Building\Minecraft\`

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `settings.gradle.kts` | Project `rootrecord-minecraft`; auto-`include("plugins:<name>")` for each `plugins/*/build.gradle.kts`; halted under `halted:<name>` |
| `build.gradle.kts` | Shared Paper compileOnly (local paper-api jar or Maven), JDK toolchain (~25), `publishPlugins`, deploy to handoff/web |
| Per-plugin | `plugins/<name>/build.gradle.kts` + `src/main/java` + `plugin.yml` |
| Shared lib | `plugins/rootrecord-common` |
| Template | `plugin-template/` (not auto-loaded as a real plugin) |

**rootmc** module extras: HikariCP, MySQL connector, compileOnly Vault + PlaceholderAPI (`plugins\rootmc\build.gradle.kts`).

**~40+ active plugin modules** under `plugins/` (rootmc, rootmc-official, root-claims, root-economy, …). No skills module among them.

Build entrypoint (workspace rule): `.\build-with-server-jdk.bat publishPlugins` from `Plugin Building\Minecraft`.

---

### 5. AdvancedSkills / Skills Odyssey / skill trees

**Zero matches** across the workspace (java/kt/yml/md/json/sql/ts/mjs searches).

Closest related names are stock mcMMO only:

- `skillranks.yml` — subskill **rank unlock levels** (not a custom skill tree product)
- `coreskills.yml` — per-skill subskill enable toggles
- Help copy: `/mcstats`, `/mctop` in `roothelp.yml` / `root-play` roothelp

---

### Integration flow (short)

```
mcMMO (jar) → MySQL mcmmo_users / mcmmo_skills
                    ↓
         McMMOStatsReader (RootMC)
           ├── PAPI: %rootmc_mcmmo_power%
           └── SyncTask → CloudApiClient → D1 rootstat_mcmmo_stats
                                              ↓
                                    Web / Android leaderboards & me
```

Official’s optional peer `GREATEST` merge exists in code but is **disabled** on live Claims/Towny because the MySQL DB is already shared.
